newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation Aug 31-Sept 9 up 0.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation Aug 31-Sept 9 up 0.1 percent.

text.p: Russian consumer prices rose 0.1 percent over 10 days ending September 9, the State Statistics Committee said on Thursday.
It said it had not yet compiled weekly figures for the first week of September. Prices fell 0.1 percent in the four days to August 30.
Consumer prices fell 0.2 percent in August -- the first fall since economic reforms began and prices were freed in 1992 -- after rising 0.7 percent in July.
Since the beginning of the year, prices have risen 16.2 percent.
